drafts.article_title: A Concrete Definition of “Product Sense” (and How to Build It)
drafts.summary_for_business: Product sense involves using patterns learned through experimentation to anticipate which product decisions are likely to succeed, while recognizing when those patterns apply.
pros: Emphasizes applying patterns in the right context
cons: Requires reliable experimentation and pattern recognition
Patterns may not apply in every situation
drafts.recommended_action: Use experimentation to build a library of product patterns, then evaluate whether each pattern fits the specific decision context before acting.
drafts.citation_anchor: A Concrete Definition of “Product Sense” (and How to Build It) Product sense means predicting which product decisions will succeed based on patterns learned through experimentation — and knowing when those patterns apply.

drafts.article_title: UX-Context Design: Using UX Knowledge to Inform AI-Generated Design
drafts.summary_for_business: As AI-generated interface work increases, UX research and design outputs should evolve from human-oriented documents into curated context that effectively guides AI.
pros: Helps apply UX knowledge directly to AI-generated design work
May make research and design guidance more usable by AI systems
Encourages a shift toward curated, actionable design context
cons: Requires adapting existing UX documentation practices
The quality of AI-generated design may depend on how well context is curated
drafts.recommended_action: Assess current UX research and design documentation, then develop curated context formats that can guide AI-generated interface work while preserving essential UX knowledge.
drafts.citation_anchor: UX-Context Design: Using UX Knowledge to Inform AI-Generated Design As more interface work is AI-generated, the output of research and design shifts from documents written for humans to curated context that guides AI.

drafts.article_title: Does Your Form Really Need a Dropdown List?
drafts.summary_for_business: Dropdown lists are appropriate only in narrow, specific scenarios. Misusing them may create more harm than choosing alternative input methods.
pros: Can be suitable for narrow, specific scenarios
cons: Misuse can cause more harm than alternatives
drafts.recommended_action: Use dropdown lists selectively and evaluate alternative input methods when the scenario is not narrow or specific.
drafts.citation_anchor: Does Your Form Really Need a Dropdown List? Dropdown lists can be used in narrow, specific scenarios, but misuse can cause more harm than alternatives.
